about: Licence a pharmacist or assistant pharmacist to work at a facility.
note: Requirements read from the official MOHAP service page on the checked date. Field labels sit behind sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: At least two years of experience
No more than a two-year gap in work record
Assessment certificate is valid for five years
documents: Academic certificates and recent experience certificates
Valid assessment certificate and criminal clearance
Facility's licence request letter, job offer and employment contract
Passport, residence permit, Emirates ID and labour card copies
List of controlled medicines for official pharmacists
